note: PinpointSimple narration. Main voice af_heart; the user's spoken note uses am_michael with a light phone-mic EQ. Lines are start-anchored; build-audio-simple.mjs measures each line and writes captions.generated.json.

lines.text: Your AI agent just finished a plan. It needs your OK.
But you're not at your desk. You have your glasses.
Today, glasses give you two buttons. Yes, or no.
But step four signs out every customer.
Yes ships the mistake. No throws away six good steps.
Pinpoint lets you point at the exact step, and say what to change.
Tap, and say what to change.
Don't sign everyone out. Just fix the broken logins.
Every step you skip counts as agreed.
Your agent gets exact, quoted feedback, and keeps working.
Need the full text? It's in Telegram, with your note pinned to the exact sentence.
It works for anything your agents write.
Pinpoint. Ring for where. Voice for what.
